## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      3 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 20 июн. 2026 г. - 8 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _zymbalaria_, 8 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Ich habe extra mit Diamanten das 7-Tage-Streak-Schild gekauft, welches als aktiv angezeigt wurde. Trotzdem wurde mein Streak von 306 Tagen gelöscht. Der Support speist mich per Mail mit Textbausteinen ab („systemseitig nicht möglich“), während das Social-Media-Team hier im App Store per Standard-Antwort genau auf diesen Support verweist. Ein reines Ablenkungsmanöver! Ein technischer Bug eurer App löscht gekaufte Schutzschilde, und zahlende Kunden werden im Stich gelassen. Mein Abo läuft am 19.08. aus und bleibt definitiv gekündigt!"
            2. _Dyakonova_, 31 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "Very disappointed with both the app and its customer support. I paid for this app and used it every single day on the same phone, spending hours logging my meals. I even have Screen Time reports proving my daily usage. After losing my streak due to what appears to be a technical issue, I contacted support with evidence, but they refused to restore it or offer any compensation. On top of that, the photo analysis is often inaccurate. In my experience, it frequently miscalculates calories and other nutritional values, so I often have to correct them manually. It’s frustrating to pay for an app, invest so much time in it, and then receive no real help when something goes wrong. If keeping your streak matters to you, be aware that support may not help you if you encounter a technical issue."
            3. _blumenkaft_, 1 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "At one time this was an efficient tracker, but now it’s bloated and frustrating. They could have prioritized improving database accuracy, purging duplicate entries, or barcode reliability, but I guess that’s actual work. Instead we have a broken app where they change the icon every month and add time-wasting gamification elements that don’t even work! Lol, every day I earn a chest of ‘diamonds’ that can’t even be collected."
